description: Defines the RocketDataSource class, a custom UI element for handling data sources and rendering circular button layouts in the Unvanquished game UI, utilizing RmlUi library.

classes.name: RocketDataSource
classes.description: A custom UI element that interfaces with a data source, manages data updates, and arranges child elements in a circular layout with a cancel button.

methods.name: SetDataSource
methods.description: Sets the data source for the element and attaches itself as a listener.

methods.name: OnAttributeChange
methods.description: Handles changes to element attributes such as 'source', 'fields', and 'formatter', updating internal state accordingly.

methods.name: OnRowAdd
methods.description: Marks the data query as dirty when a row is added to the data source.

methods.name: OnRowChange
methods.description: Marks the data query as dirty when a row is changed in the data source.

methods.name: OnRowRemove
methods.description: Marks the data query as dirty when a row is removed from the data source.

methods.name: OnUpdate
methods.description: Rebuilds child elements based on current data, formatting data and arranging child elements in a circular pattern.

methods.name: ProcessDefaultAction
methods.description: Handles 'mouseover' events to identify the target button and dispatch a 'rowselect' event with relevant parameters.

methods.name: LayoutChildren
methods.description: Positions child elements in a circular layout around the center, with the first child centered as a cancel button.

methods.name: AddCancelbutton
methods.description: Creates and adds a cancel button as the first child element.
